rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone nominated to stand for election or selection for a position.

example.english: All the nominee candidates for this district council election have been announced.
example.traditional: 今次區議會選舉嘅候選人已經全部公布。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 keoi1 ji5 wui2 syun2 geoi2 ge3 hau6 syun2 jan4 ji5 ging1 cyun4 bou6 gung1 bou3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person has been nominated, especially for a post or award rather than actively standing in an election.

example.english: One nominee ultimately won Best Actor.
example.traditional: 其中一位被提名人最後攞咗最佳男主角。
example.jyutping: kei4 zung1 jat1 wai6 bei6 tai4 ming4 jan4 zeoi3 hau6 lo2 zo2 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3
